title: Implement checkout total with discount and tax
description: Implement orderTotalCents in lab/coding-task/src/checkout.js for a small e-commerce checkout. Calculate the cart subtotal, apply the supplied percentage discount, then apply the supplied percentage tax to the discounted subtotal. Return an integer number of cents using normal rounding. Preserve the cart input without mutation. Keep the implementation focused on this function and do not refactor unrelated modules.
